theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_det_tangential_gram_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin k) ℝ P) (Λ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin N ↦ inner ℝ (Λ (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (Λ (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a c : Fin k ↦ inner ℝ (Λ (b a)) (Λ (b c)))
